# Miscellaneous › Combat Action

> Use this oracle to help inspire an action for a foe in a fight. When you’re not sure what an enemy does next, particularly when they have you in a bad spot, roll on this table and interpret the result as appropriate to the nature of the enemy and your objective.
>
> Datasworn `oracle_rollable:starforged/misc/combat_action` · 1d100

- [3] Cause reckless damage
- [3] Change weapons or tactics

- [3] Coordinate with allies
- [3] Corner, trap, or entangle
- [3] Counter or reflect an attack
- [3] Create a distraction
- [3] Destroy something or render it useless
- [3] Fall back or stand off
- [3] Hide or sneak
- [3] Intimidate, taunt, or frighten

- [3] Make a precise or careful attack

- [3] Make an indirect attack
- [3] Move in close or grapple
- [3] Nullify a system, device, or weapon

- [3] Press an advantage
